# IB Prophet

> Pick your IB Diploma subjects and discover the university pathways and careers they unlock.

IB Prophet is a free tool for International Baccalaureate (IB) Diploma students. Students select their 3 Higher Level (HL) and 3 Standard Level (SL) subjects, and the app shows which university degree pathways match and which careers those pathways lead to — with salary data (US & UK), AI resilience ratings, and 10-year growth outlooks.

Website: https://ibprophet-client.fly.dev

## How it works

1. Pick 3 HL and 3 SL subjects from the IB Diploma curriculum.
2. See matching university pathways ranked by fit.
3. Explore career outcomes for each pathway — including salary ranges, growth outlook, AI resilience, and pros/cons.

## Careers covered (29)

Each career page includes entry and mid-career salaries (US & UK), 10-year job growth %, AI resilience rating (Green/Yellow/Red), pros, cons, and the university pathways that lead there.

- [Software Engineer](https://ibprophet-client.fly.dev/career/software-engineer) — Design, build, and maintain software applications and systems.
- [Doctor (General Practitioner)](https://ibprophet-client.fly.dev/career/doctor-general-practitioner) — Diagnose and treat illnesses, provide preventive care, and manage patient health.
- [Investment Banker](https://ibprophet-client.fly.dev/career/investment-banker) — Advise corporations on mergers, acquisitions, and capital raising.
- [Mechanical Engineer](https://ibprophet-client.fly.dev/career/mechanical-engineer) — Design and develop mechanical systems, from engines to robotics.
- [Lawyer](https://ibprophet-client.fly.dev/career/lawyer) — Represent clients in legal matters, draft contracts, and argue cases in court.
- [Clinical Psychologist](https://ibprophet-client.fly.dev/career/clinical-psychologist) — Assess, diagnose, and treat mental health conditions through therapy and research.
- [Management Consultant](https://ibprophet-client.fly.dev/career/management-consultant) — Advise organisations on strategy, operations, and organisational improvement.
- [Architect](https://ibprophet-client.fly.dev/career/architect) — Design buildings and spaces that are functional, safe, and aesthetically compelling.
- [Diplomat](https://ibprophet-client.fly.dev/career/diplomat) — Represent a country's interests abroad, negotiate treaties, and manage international relations.
- [Environmental Scientist](https://ibprophet-client.fly.dev/career/environmental-scientist) — Research and advise on environmental issues including pollution, conservation, and climate change.
- [Film Director / Producer](https://ibprophet-client.fly.dev/career/film-director-producer) — Lead creative vision for film and media projects, managing teams and production.
- [Product Manager](https://ibprophet-client.fly.dev/career/product-manager) — Define product strategy, prioritise features, and coordinate engineering and design teams.
- [Data Analyst](https://ibprophet-client.fly.dev/career/data-analyst) — Collect, process, and analyse data to help organisations make informed decisions.
- [Accountant](https://ibprophet-client.fly.dev/career/accountant) — Prepare and examine financial records, ensure compliance, and advise on tax strategy.
- [Secondary School Teacher](https://ibprophet-client.fly.dev/career/secondary-school-teacher) — Teach specialist subjects to students aged 11-18 in secondary schools.
- [Primary School Teacher](https://ibprophet-client.fly.dev/career/primary-school-teacher) — Teach core subjects and support holistic development of children aged 4-11.
- [HR Professional](https://ibprophet-client.fly.dev/career/hr-professional) — Manage recruitment, employee relations, training, and workplace policy.
- [Marketing & PR Professional](https://ibprophet-client.fly.dev/career/marketing-pr-professional) — Develop campaigns, manage brand reputation, and communicate with target audiences.
- [Graphic & Multimedia Designer](https://ibprophet-client.fly.dev/career/graphic-multimedia-designer) — Create visual content for print, digital, and interactive media using design software.
- [Journalist / Writer](https://ibprophet-client.fly.dev/career/journalist-writer) — Research, write, and publish stories for newspapers, magazines, websites, or broadcast media.
- [Police Officer](https://ibprophet-client.fly.dev/career/police-officer) — Maintain public safety, investigate crimes, and enforce the law within communities.
- [Social Worker](https://ibprophet-client.fly.dev/career/social-worker) — Support vulnerable individuals and families, safeguard children, and connect people with services.
- [Civil Engineer](https://ibprophet-client.fly.dev/career/civil-engineer) — Design and oversee construction of infrastructure — roads, bridges, buildings, and water systems.
- [Actuary](https://ibprophet-client.fly.dev/career/actuary) — Use mathematics, statistics, and financial theory to assess risk for insurance and pensions.
- [Cyber Security Professional](https://ibprophet-client.fly.dev/career/cyber-security-professional) — Protect organisations from cyber threats by designing, monitoring, and responding to security incidents.
- [Biologist / Lab Scientist](https://ibprophet-client.fly.dev/career/biologist-lab-scientist) — Conduct research in genetics, microbiology, ecology, or biomedical science in labs and the field.
- [Physiotherapist](https://ibprophet-client.fly.dev/career/physiotherapist) — Help patients recover movement and manage pain through exercise, manual therapy, and education.
- [Events Manager](https://ibprophet-client.fly.dev/career/events-manager) — Plan, coordinate, and deliver events from conferences to festivals and corporate functions.
- [Quantity Surveyor](https://ibprophet-client.fly.dev/career/quantity-surveyor) — Manage costs on construction projects from initial estimates through to final accounts.

## IB subjects supported (39)

Group 1 (Language & Literature): English A: Language and Literature, English A: Literature, French A: Literature, Italian A: Literature, German A: Literature, Japanese A: Literature, Russian A: Literature, Chinese A: Literature, Turkish A: Literature, Vietnamese A: Literature, Hebrew A: Literature

Group 2 (Language Acquisition): English B, Spanish B, French B, German B, Italian B, Chinese B, Russian B, Spanish Ab Initio, French Ab Initio, Mandarin Ab Initio

Group 3 (Individuals & Societies): Economics, History, Business Management, Psychology, Global Politics

Group 4 (Sciences): Environmental Systems and Societies, Sports Exercise and Health Science, Biology, Chemistry, Physics, Computer Science, Design Technology

Group 5 (Mathematics): Mathematics: Analysis and Approaches, Mathematics: Applications and Interpretation

Group 6 (The Arts): Visual Arts, Music, Theatre, Film, Dance
